dct_description_sm: This data set presents, for each building on the Island of Montreal, an estimate of the technical solar photovoltaic potential of roofs, i.e.: the identified roof area, the installable photovoltaic capacity (expressed in nominal DC power of the panels), as well as the average annual electricity production that can be generated.**This third party metadata element was translated using an automated translation tool (Amazon Translate).**
